title: Macos ARM Linking Error when using MoltenVK v1.4.321.0
body:
### Tested versions

- Happened with Godot version 4.4.2 [e531f3e] and MoltenVK v1.4.321.0 (latest at the time of writing this)
- Switching MoltenVK to version 1.3.268.1 Fixed the issue

### System information

Macos 14.3 arm64 - Godot 4.4.2 - XCode 15.4

### Issue description

Simply running `scons` (using default arguments: platform="macos" arch="arm64" target="editor")
Compilation of all sources works fine.
Once at the linking step the following error occurs:

```
[100%] Linking Program bin/godot.macos.editor.arm64 ...
[100%] Undefined symbols for architecture arm64:
  "_OBJC_CLASS_$_MTLResidencySetDescriptor", referenced from:
      objc-class-ref in libMoltenVK.a(libMoltenVK.a-arm64-master.o)
ld: symbol(s) not found for architecture arm64
clang: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)
scons: *** [bin/godot.macos.editor.arm64] Error 1
scons: building terminated because of errors.
```

As said before, switching MoltenVK to an older version (1.3.268.1) fixes the issue and links correctly.

I don't know much about i/mac os development, and there might be a good reason for this (and potentially other) version of MoltenVK to not be backwards compatible, but unfortunately the [Docs](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/4.4/contributing/development/compiling/compiling_for_macos.html) reference an url to download MoltenVK which always grabs the latest version, and the `misc/scripts/install_vulkan_sdk_macos.sh` script also downloads the latest version.
